jdText:
Lead / Principal Android Engineer

We are hiring a Lead Android Engineer to set architecture direction across multiple squads. Requirements: 7+ years Android, proven Kotlin Multiplatform or multi-module architecture experience, a track record of measurable reliability or performance improvements (crash rate, load time), experience running interview loops or hiring, and comfort owning a platform end to end including build and release pipelines. Compose and Coroutines expected.
